description:
Number of people with an approved National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) plan living in each council area, state and Australia, every quarter from December 2021 to June 2026.

Coverage: About 510 council areas (councils with fewer than 11 participants are suppressed), all 8 states and territories, and Australia; quarterly from October 2021 (December 2021 quarter-end) to April 2026 (June 2026 quarter-end). Period is the first day of the quarter. Current to 2026-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/ndis-participants`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: participants. Omit for all.

state.description: State or territory abbreviation: nsw, vic, qld, sa, wa, tas, act or nt.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
